summary: Web-fallback launch regression — ALL 6 flows PASS end-to-end at 390x844 mobile web viewport. Backend pytest 6/6 (test_web_fallbacks.py): login/auth/me OK; /products/by-barcode/{code} returns 200 with matching product and 404 for unknown; /barcode-lookup/{code} external lookup returns 200 with {found: bool}; DELETE /api/account with a freshly registered throwaway user returns {ok:true, deleted:true}, the previous JWT stops working (401 on /auth/me), and re-login with the same email/password returns 401 — cascading deletion of owned warehouses/products verified via API before delete. DELETE /api/account with no auth correctly returns 403. Frontend web (warehouse@test.com/test123): (1) Scan tab at /scan (bottom nav) shows manual-barcode Field + manual-lookup Btn only, NO camera prompt; typing an existing product's barcode returns the scan-result-sheet with product name + in-stock qty + Receive/Update Stock Btn. (2) /stocktakes -> st-new-btn -> st-create opens the detail; std-scan opens the BarcodeScannerModal web fallback (scanner-manual + scanner-manual-submit + scanner-close). A non-matching barcode shows the exact 'That product is not in this stocktake.' web alert; a matching barcode (BC1d786716cb) closes the modal and highlights/scrolls to the TEST_PICK_2025de row (orange border) — no crash, no camera. (3) /sales-order/{id} of a SAVED order (created via API with 3 units of the same product) — so-scan-pick opens scanner-manual, a matching barcode opens the pick-qty popup (pick-qty-input + pick-save with 'Demanded: 3' and value 3 prefilled). (4) /product/new on web shows ONLY photo-gallery ('Choose photo') — photo-camera is NOT rendered on web (Platform.OS==='web' branch). File-chooser upload of a tiny PNG succeeds: photo-remove button appears and a preview is rendered (upload -> /api/upload returns a path saved to form.image). (5) Register a throwaway user (reg-name/reg-email/reg-password/reg-submit -> auto-signs in and lands on '/'), navigate to /settings, tap delete-account-btn (window.confirm auto-accepted on web): app returns to /login screen, and re-login with the same credentials fails with the visible error 'Incorrect email or password'. (6) Regression: /login works, dashboard renders (dash-wh-*, stat-*, view-all-movements), /catalog renders (add-product-btn + product rows), /orders (Tools hub) renders. NO Expo/React Native deprecated packages, red screens, or crashes observed. NO camera permission prompt on any web path.

app/(tabs)/scan.tsx: web branch (isDesktop || Platform.OS==='web') swaps CameraView for Field manual-barcode + Btn manual-lookup and reuses the same doLookup(data) code path — no duplication, consistent scan-result-sheet.

ProductEditor.tsx L200-203: photo-camera button correctly gated on Platform.OS !== 'web'; photo-gallery is always shown. pickImage() also short-circuits to launchImageLibraryAsync on web when fromCamera=true. Good.

settings.tsx confirmDeleteAccount / onDeleteAccount split cleanly by Platform.OS (window.confirm on web, Alert.alert on native). Uses the shared auth.deleteAccount() which calls DELETE /api/account with the bearer token.

server.py DELETE /api/account (L1527-1545) cascades correctly: dissolves company if owner, delete_many across warehouses/categories/suppliers/products/movements/purchase_orders/sales_orders/stocktakes/production_orders/stock_snapshots owned by uid, clears so_counters, then deletes the user. Returns {ok, deleted}. Old JWT auto-invalidated because get_current_user re-fetches user by id and returns 401 when missing.

Consistency note (NON-BLOCKING): server.py L1539 lists collections in a tuple; consider also pruning transfers/movements that reference the deleted user via warehouse_id ownership implicitly (currently movements are owner_id-scoped, so covered). No action needed.
